path.description: Relative path (from project-dir) to the produced artifact. The CLI finalize gate verifies each path exists and is non-empty.

platform.description: Platform this output was produced for.

diagnostic.description: Wire shape for a single structured diagnostic — the neutral currency shared by both Specify check surfaces. Shared by deterministic scanners (`specify lint`), the workflow-gating validate surface (`specify slice validate`), framework JSON export (`specify lint framework --format json`), target-adapter review briefs, model-assisted scorers, CI annotations, and dashboards. Field names are kebab-case at every nesting level. Producer-local `id` is distinct from the codex `rule-id` — `id` is a stable per-run handle (e.g. `FIND-0001`) and `rule-id` is the durable codex citation (e.g. `UNI-014`). Conditional requirements that JSON Schema cannot express (e.g. `confidence` required for `source: model-assisted`) are enforced producer-side.

confidence.description: Producer confidence. Producers MUST set `confidence` for `source: model-assisted`; the conditional rule is enforced producer-side, not by this schema.

disposition.description: Origin of a non-`open` `status`. Unset when `status` is `open` or absent; required to carry `source` when present. Directive producers populate `disposition.directive`.

fingerprint.description: Stable hash of `(rule-id, location, evidence-payload)` for the diagnostic fingerprint algorithm. Excludes producer-controlled fields (`id`, `title`, `severity`, `confidence`, `status`, `disposition`, `change`, `slice`, `target-adapter`, `source-adapter`).

id.description: Producer-local stable id for this run (e.g. `FIND-0001`). NOT the rule id; report-local heading ids such as `SEC-1` or `UNI-3` also live here when emitted as JSON.

kind.description: Nature of the diagnostic: `violation` (a defect) or `review` (a deterministically-raised request for agent/human judgment). Omitted defaults to `violation`.

location.description: File path plus optional line, column, and end positions. Omitted for findings without a single anchor location; per-file evidence may carry `locations[]` instead.

related-rule-ids.description: Additional codex ids that informed the finding.

remediation.description: Concrete action to clear the finding.

rule-id.description: Rule id (e.g. `UNI-014`). Required when the finding maps to a rule; absent for findings that do not cite codex policy.

slice.description: Slice name when the finding is slice-scoped.

source-adapter.description: Source-adapter name when the finding is source-extraction-specific.

status.description: Triage status. Omitted by raw scanners; populated by review reports, the directive post-pass, or CI state. The `ignored` value is set by the directive post-pass on findings matched by a `specify-ignore` directive; `false-positive` is set by the same pass when the directive's rationale begins with `false-positive:`. `open` is the only default-blocking value.

target-adapter.description: Target-adapter name when the finding is adapter-specific.

diagnostic.title: Specify Diagnostic

diagnostic-diagnosticKind.description: Orthogonal nature axis. `violation` marks a deterministic defect; `review` marks a deterministically-raised request for agent or human judgment (e.g. a deferred semantic check). Only `violation` findings are default-blocking.

diagnostic-disposition.description: Origin of a non-`open` finding status. `source` is the closed discriminator and is always required when the disposition object is present.

directive.description: Directive disposition payload populated when `source: directive`.

line.description: 1-based line of the directive comment itself (not the target line that the directive applies to).

path.description: Project-relative path of the source file containing the `specify-ignore` directive.

rationale.description: Free-form rationale captured verbatim from the directive comment. Short rationales (< 16 characters) still populate this field, and unrationaled directives populate the empty string; the directive-validation pass emits `UNI-022` for both cases. The wire shape carries the captured rationale verbatim so downstream tooling can render the raw text alongside the synthetic finding.

since.description: Optional free-form marker indicating when the disposition took effect (e.g. a commit hash, ISO-8601 timestamp, or release tag). Current emitters leave this unset; reserved for downstream tooling.

source.description: Origin of the non-`open` status decision. Directive producers emit `directive`; a future baseline mechanism would widen this enum additively.

diagnostic-evidence.description: Evidence union for structured diagnostics. Closed `kind` discriminator with one legal field set per branch. Evidence payloads have a 16 KiB cap after UTF-8 serialization (enforced producer-side, not by this schema). Diagnostics MUST NOT include secrets, full prompts, model transcripts, or full source files.

value.description: Bounded verbatim excerpt for local code or prose evidence.

locations.description: Optional contributing locations referenced by the digest.

sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of the underlying evidence.

data.description: Domain evidence payload (e.g. contract compatibility metadata). Producers must keep `data` bounded and secret-free.

diagnostic-findingId.description: Producer-local stable id. Examples: `FIND-0001`, `SEC-1`, `UNI-3`. Letters and digits with internal hyphens; ends with a numeric tail. Distinct from the codex `rule-id` namespace.

diagnostic-kebabName.description: Kebab-case identifier matching slice and plan naming. No cross-artifact regex is pinned for `slice` / `change`; this kebab shape is consistent with existing Specify naming.

diagnostic-relativePathPattern.description: Project-relative path. Absolute paths, URI strings, and `..` segments are rejected.

diagnostic-ruleId.description: Two namespaces share this field. The codex family (`UNI-014`, `CORE-003`, …) mirrors `codex/resolved.schema.json#/$defs/ruleId` and `schemas/rules/rule.schema.json#/$defs/ruleId`. The dot-/kebab-namespaced runtime-validation family (`spec.requirement-id-missing`, `merge.no-duplicate-ids`, `slice-model-source-orphan`) carries the structural workflow invariant ids that `validate` surfaces emit as diagnostics.

diagnostic-severity.description: Closed review severity enum, ordered for sort stability (`critical < important < suggestion < optional`).

platform.description: Closed target platform enum. Mirrors the `platform` $def in `target.schema.json`.

screens.description: Count of screen-bearing requirements this slice introduces or modifies, per the build brief's own `spec.md` judgement. `0` means the slice has no UI surface.

description: Generated judgment-answer schema — derived from schemas/target/build-report.schema.json (with schemas/diagnostics/diagnostic.schema.json inlined) by specify-schema's answer derivation; do not edit. Validates the schema-gated answer to a target adapter's build or merge operation: the canonical report shape minus the envelope keys (`version`, `slice`, `target`) the caller already knows.

findings.description: Diagnostics; default `[]`. On `success`, only non-blocking findings (or empty). On `failure`, populated with blocking (`critical` / `important`) violations when the target can map them.

outputs.description: Per-platform build outputs produced by the target adapter. Each entry declares a platform and a relative path (from project-dir) to the produced artifact. The CLI finalize gate verifies every declared path exists and is non-empty (`target-build-output-missing`).

status.description: `success` or `failure`. Partial success is `success` with non-blocking findings only.

ui-surface.description: Per-slice UI-surface signal authored by the build brief from its own `spec.md` screen-identification judgement (never from `## Platforms`). Optional and additive — reports without it stay valid. The CLI finalize phase compares it against the produced `composition.yaml` and emits the non-blocking `composition-unexpected-for-non-ui-slice` / `composition-empty-for-ui-slice` warnings on a mismatch.

title: Specify build/merge answer
